notes: Cards marked (start) in the post: Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, one Prince Xizor, Twi'lek Advisor and Presence Of The Force, with the Objective Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince; these count. Total is 60 as published.
The post says this deck won 'last Hawaii tourney' (event not named); kept as a general deck.
Posted 'Coruscant' dested Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition) (the Coruscant set was not out yet); 'CoruscantCapital City' dested Coruscant: Imperial City, the site Agents Of Black Sun starts.

Posted 'Tatooine', 'TatooineCantina' and 'Jabba's PalaceAudience Chamber' dested the Dark printings Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere), Tatooine: Cantina (Dark) and Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber (Dark); 'TatooineJabba's Palace' dested the Dark Tatooine: Jabba's Palace.

Posted 'Iggy with Riot Gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Omni Box/It's Worse' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Boba Fett in Slave 1' dested Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Agents of The Black Sun/Vengeance of The Dark Prince' dested the Objective.
Secret Plans was a 2001 Effect, not a Defensive Shield.
